title: Scenario C — Ambiguity
description: A request for a volunteer, a second similar task, then a volunteer who could mean either: the app shows the options instead of guessing.

expected.note: An unassigned task: nobody is named, so no owner is invented.

messages.text: Can someone review the slides for the client deck?

TASK: review the slides for the client deck

expected.note: A second, similar unassigned task (flagged as a possible duplicate, not merged).
Two unassigned tasks could be meant: the options are shown and nothing changes until a person chooses.
